workflows.workflow: Inherited access, moves, delayed index writes and retained direct grants
workflows.result: Ordinary and offset-deep searches now recheck graph access; continuation already did. Moves update inherited openness without erasing direct grants.

workflows.workflow: Inclusion propagation overtaken by publication, editing or first instances
workflows.result: Publication is checked against the fetched revision. Structural propagation fences stored and in-flight instances, and instance writes require the exact template revision used for validation. Concurrent edits remain ETag-protected.

workflows.workflow: Ownership transfers during background instance cloning
workflows.result: Registration holds source and destination graph locks while checking their current owner and creating the clone and provenance; rejected registration conditionally removes its new content revision.

workflows.workflow: Concurrent next drafts and retry after a lost client response
workflows.result: Existing version-chain guard holds: one successor, one clone job, and conditional cleanup of the losing document. Client cancellation followed by retry does not duplicate work.

workflows.workflow: Interrupted recursive deletion followed by a changed tree or lost acknowledgement
workflows.result: Existing confirmation protocol holds: stop on failure, reject stale confirmation, preserve moved subtrees, use edited content revisions, and refuse newly introduced outside references. Unknown outcomes require re-inventory.
